title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: We knew about gyros and salads before coming to Greece, and in all honesty, those were our staples.
Kostas in Athens is a legendary join for gyros. And it lived up to the hype!
We were also blown away by the bird livers served at Yiasemi, a rooftop bistro in Plaka, Athens.
Melitini, a fancy Greek tapas spot, was our favourite in Oia, Santorini.
